# `aitbc node add`

Add a new node to the local configuration.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc node add [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--node-id` | text | — | yes | The Node id. |
| `--endpoint` | text | — | yes | The Endpoint. |
| `--timeout` | integer | `30` | no | Request timeout in seconds |
| `--max-connections` | integer | `10` | no | Maximum concurrent connections |
| `--retry-count` | integer | `3` | no | Number of retry attempts |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc node add --node-id <node_id> --endpoint <endpoint>
```
